trip.text: So last spring I finally flew to Lisbon with my sister.
The first morning we found a tiny cafe near the tram stop.
They pulled the best espresso I have ever tasted in my life.
By the way the weather has been strange all week back home.
It rained on Monday and then it was sunny again on Tuesday.
Anyway my friend Marco is building a startup about invoices.
He told me investors only care about monthly recurring revenue.
We rode the old yellow tram up the steepest hill in the city.
At the top a stranger played the guitar and nobody wanted to leave.
Marco says the seed round closes in March if the numbers hold.
That night we ate grilled sardines by the river and laughed for hours.
Honestly I should check the forecast before I plan the weekend.
The hostel owner gave us a map with her favorite hidden places.
My sister cried a little when the plane took off to bring us home.
Marco also wants me to join as an advisor which is flattering.
I would go back tomorrow and take the same tram to the same hill.

decoy.text: Last summer in Lisbon I tasted the best espresso at a hostel by the tram line.
My cousin runs a Lisbon startup that sells espresso machines to every hostel.
Its investors ride the tram of venture hype and want the hostel market first.
The tram then carried us uphill while a stranger played guitar for the street.

turkish.text: Geçen yaz ailemle birlikte Kapadokya'ya gittik.
Sabah erkenden balonlara binmek için kalktık.
Bu arada şirketimizin yeni fatura yazılımı çok iyi gidiyor.
Balondan gördüğüm manzara hayatımın en güzel anıydı.
İstanbul'a dönünce bu kadar mutlu olduğumu kimseye anlatamadım.
Kapadokya balon şirketlerinin hisse senedi manzarası çok riskli görünüyor.
